title: HipHo's Modpack
description: A vanilla+ (vanilla plus) modpack that I use with shaders, resource packs and mods, all client-side
body:
This is my modpack; I use it to play servers such as Cubecraft. It includes mods, shaders, and resource packs (all are recommended to be enabled). Thanks; hope you like it! Note: No need to say this was my modpack, etc.

This modpack includes many vanilla + mods, enabling a nice experience with resource packs like Fresh Animations, shader packs like Complementary and Solas, optimisation mods like Sodium, and quality-of-life mods like 3D skin layers and AppleSkin.
